explainer: intro
Meet Ask Mavis. Friendly help with your phone, your telly, and more.
tap
When something stops working, you don't need to know what it's called. Just tap the big blue button, and say what's wrong, in your own words.
check
Mavis shows you what she heard, so you can check it.
intro2
Then she explains the fix, calmly, with no jargon.
steps
One small step at a time, in big writing, and read out loud. The green button is always at the bottom, so you never lose your place.
oneword
Fed up? Just say one word, like Netflix, and pick from big, simple buttons.
services
There's help with booking the doctor, repeat prescriptions, banking, WhatsApp and photos.
safety
And Mavis always puts your safety first, with clear warnings about scams.
practice
You can even practise using a takeaway ordering screen at home, with no queue, and nobody watching.
outro
Ask Mavis. Free to download, made in the UK, with no adverts. Help, whenever you need it.
